verdict.rationale: Close is a SaaS CRM, and a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The pack covers only the API, webhooks, MCP, pricing and the Chloe agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
